       ( (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) ) AS gap

), oldest_female AS (
  SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_bd FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'

       (agg.max_a11 - agg.min_a11) AS gap
FROM client c

JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
CROSS JOIN agg
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT min_bd FROM oldest_female)
  AND dist.A11 = agg.min_a11;

    AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id,
       (aggs.max_a11 - aggs.min_a11) AS gap
FROM oldest_f o

JOIN district dist ON o.district_id = dist.district_id

WHERE dist.A11 = aggs.min_a11;

FROM Team t
JOIN (
  SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_bup
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
    AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY team_api_id
) ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.avg_bup > (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bup)
  FROM (
    SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_bup
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
      AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team_api_id
  ) AS per_team
);
